response_ids.READY-TIER: A readiness tier summarizes approved intake information and is not a diagnosis.
response_ids.DAILY-INSIGHT: Saved daily insights are separate from intake scoring and do not automatically change the readiness tier.
response_ids.MISSING-STATE: An incomplete status means the app does not have enough approved information to display a readiness tier.
response_ids.CONSENT: A person can withdraw a sharing permission. Authorized access must honor the latest permission state.
